registry_info.description: Endless Museum Dream-Body sculptural formations and Bauhaus worker assemblages for the Void Tower and around Playground Workbenches.

worker_assemblage.name: Worker Form & Dream-Body Assemblage
worker_assemblage.description: Stages the humanoid Playground Worker (WorkerBeing) alongside curated Endless Museum DreamBodies sculptures in solo, dyad, trio, hybrid assemblage, or workbench_arc formations. Enforces monochrome architectural finish before Color (F28) and unlocks full sculptural colour + palette harmony on Color floors and F209, with flush interactive FORM / AXIS / MODE controls.
